resource_load.operations_per_request: 2 + N (where N = number of repos returned, each needs permission check)
resource_load.note: N+1 query pattern: 1 query for repos + N queries for permissions

performance_issues.description: For each repository in the team, GetDoerRepoPermission is called individually, resulting in N+1 database queries
performance_issues.impact: If a team has 50 repos, this results in 51+ DB queries per request
performance_issues.code_snippet: for i, repo := range teamRepos { permission, err := access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, repo, ctx.Doer) }
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch permission loading or use a single query with JOIN to get permissions for all repos at once

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch permission resolution for team repos
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from N+1 queries to 2 queries for listing team repos
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Create a batch GetDoerRepoPermissions function that accepts multiple repos

resource_load.note: Fixed number of queries: team load, membership check, repo lookup, team_repo check, permission

resource_load.operations_per_request: 7 + M (where M = team members if AutoWatchNewRepos)
resource_load.note: Transaction with multiple writes; if AutoWatchNewRepos, loads all team members and inserts watch records

performance_issues.description: When AutoWatchNewRepos is enabled, WatchRepo is called individually for each team member inside the transaction
performance_issues.impact: For a team with 100 members, this adds 100 individual INSERT/UPDATE operations within the transaction
performance_issues.code_snippet: for _, u := range t.Members { if err = repo_model.WatchRepo(ctx, u, repo, true); err != nil { ... } }
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch insert watch records for all team members in a single query

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch watch insertion for team members
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce M individual inserts to 1 batch insert
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use bulk INSERT for watch records when adding repo to team

resource_load.operations_per_request: 8 + 2*M (where M = team members, each needs access check + potential unwatch)
resource_load.note: Transaction with multiple writes; checks each member's remaining access individually

performance_issues.description: For each team member, HasAnyUnitAccess is called individually to check if they still have access, then WatchRepo/RemoveIssueWatchersByRepoID if not
performance_issues.impact: For a team with 100 members, this results in 100+ permission checks plus potential 200 delete operations
performance_issues.code_snippet: for _, member := range teamMembers { has, err := access_model.HasAnyUnitAccess(ctx, member.ID, repo) ... }
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch check remaining access for all members, then batch unwatch/remove issue watches

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch access check and unwatch for team members on repo removal
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from 2*M queries to 2-3 queries total
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use subquery to find members who have no other access, then batch delete watches

resource_load.operations_per_request: 3 + N (where N = number of teams returned, each needs LoadUnits)
resource_load.note: N+1 for LoadUnits: 1 search query + N LoadUnits queries

performance_issues.description: convert.ToTeams calls LoadUnits for each team individually
performance_issues.impact: If search returns 20 teams, this results in 20 additional queries to team_unit table
performance_issues.code_snippet: for _, t := range teams { if err := t.LoadUnits(ctx); err != nil { return nil, err } }
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load units for all teams in a single query using IN clause on team_id

optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from N+1 to 2 queries for team search
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add a LoadUnitsForTeams batch function that queries team_unit WHERE team_id IN (...)

resource_load.note: Complex query with subqueries for team repo IDs and activity visibility

performance_issues.description: AccessibleTeamReposEnv.RepoIDs fetches all repo IDs for the team without limit, which are then used in an IN clause for the action query
performance_issues.impact: If a team has thousands of repos, the IN clause could be very large
performance_issues.code_snippet: teamRepoIDs, err := env.RepoIDs(ctx) ... cond = cond.And(builder.In("repo_id", teamRepoIDs))
performance_issues.recommendation: Use a subquery instead of materializing all repo IDs into an IN clause

optimization_recommendations.description: Use subquery for team repo IDs in activity feed query
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Avoid materializing large ID lists in memory and SQL
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Replace RepoIDs() call with a builder subquery that selects repo_id from team_repo WHERE team_id = X
